messages.content: 请检索以下问题的相关原文：关于论文《UIT-ViIC: A Dataset for the First Evaluation on Vietnamese Image Captioning》，What deep neural network models are used in evaluation?

claims.text: The paper trains and evaluates its dataset with two published Image Captioning models applying an encoder-decoder architecture.
The two models used are the Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model and the Image Captioning model from the Pytorch-tutorial by Yunjey.

In the architecture, CNN is first used for extracting image features for the encoder part, and the image features represented as vectors are used as layers for decoding; for the decoder part, RNN-LSTM are used to embed the vectors to target sentences using words/tokens from the vocabulary.

The authors conducted several experiments on two popular existing Image Captioning models to evaluate their efficiency when learning two Vietnamese datasets, comparing results with the original MS-COCO English sportball category.
The introduction states that experiments were conducted to evaluate state-of-the-art models (evaluated on the English dataset) on the UIT-ViIC dataset.
